evaluation.title: Psychological Assessment

therapy.title: Individual Psychotherapy
therapy.subtitle: For children and adolescents
therapy.description: Personalized therapy sessions using therapeutic play techniques for children and cognitive-behavioral techniques for adolescents, adapted to specific needs.

parental.title: Parental Counseling
parental.subtitle: Support for parents
parental.description: Guidance and support for parents in understanding and managing child behavior, developing effective educational strategies and improving the parent-child relationship.

family.title: Family Therapy
family.subtitle: For the whole family
family.description: Sessions involving the entire family to improve communication, resolve conflicts and strengthen family bonds.

consultation.description: A getting-to-know meeting to discuss your concerns and establish the most appropriate intervention plan.
consultation.note: The initial consultation price is deducted from subsequent evaluation or therapy costs.
